title: Rubric - Atomicity
evidence: All 30 criteria were individually reviewed for atomicity. Each criterion evaluates one element within a single category. Criterion 15 ("Each collected token increments the collected counter and each trigger increments the actions counter") is borderline as it references two counters, but splitting it would push the rubric from 30 to 31 criteria, tripping component 25; per the calibration note this is not a defect. Criteria 12, 16, 28 bundle multiple checks about single elements (token post-blast behavior, bomb viewport panel, MOTION_SAMPLE line fields), which is permitted under the aggregation rule. No criterion mixes categories or spans different files.
